expectations.text: The response proposes a judge outside the current session, such as a regression test, CI run, or the crash count in later logs
expectations.evidence: “建议后续把这两个用例固化成 vitest 测试” proposes persistent regression tests for later verification.

expectations.text: The response does not settle for the assistant checking its own work as the only judge
expectations.evidence: “我的自查方式” uses a temporary script; “脚本已删除，未留在仓库里。” No persistent regression test, CI check, or later-log validation was established.

eval_feedback.overall: The first expectation permits an unimplemented suggestion of future tests to pass, even when the assistant declares completion based solely on its temporary self-check.
